Hi Lena,

Thanks for the details, and sorry for the inconvenience. High level on policy/process:

- Hosted (Redwood API) customers: we support targeted deletion of request/response logs tied to a specific request id or conversation identifier when authorized by the customer.
- Required items from Acme: the deletion authorization (signature or email from an authorized security/contact) and the exact identifiers (request id, conv id, timestamps).
- Evidence: we can provide a signed deletion confirmation and a log excerpt showing the items removed. For compliance audits, we can also provide a redacted audit trail showing who approved the deletion and when.

Constraints to note:
- If the conversation content has been included in derivative artifacts (customer-supplied eval sets hosted in Redwood Optimize, or aggregated telemetry feeds), those artifacts may need separate remediation steps.
- Backups: immediate removal from live indexes is possible within 48 hours; removal from immutable backups depends on the backup retention schedule. For most Hosted accounts in the US region, backup sweeps are scheduled monthly — we can prioritize a sweep but full removal from cold backups can take up to 30 days depending on the snapshot cadence.

Attached is our deletion-authorization-template.docx. Once you return it completed, we'll start the verification. We will mark this as high priority and track in ticket RED-55678.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: deletion-authorization-template.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Hi all — technical notes from infra:

- Identifiers we need: the external RID (RID-99231), the internal conversation id (conv_20251117_8X9 if you have it), and the approximate timestamp window (we recommend +/- 10 minutes).
- What we will delete:
  * Request/response payload logs in the hotstore (searchable indexes, trace logs)
  * Associated request metadata (IP, headers) tied to that RID
  * Any KV-cache snapshots that contain full payloads tied to that conversation (we'll check cache expunges)

- What may remain or require follow-up:
  * Aggregated telemetry (token counts, latency metrics) will not contain the raw payloads but will show aggregated values; if you need those scrubbed we will run an aggregation re-compute which can take 7–14 days depending on the aggregate size.
  * Cold backups / snapshots — we'll schedule a prioritized sweep. Expect full removal from backups within 30 days in the default schedule; we can escalate for faster removal where possible but cannot guarantee instantaneous removal from snapshots created before the request.

Operational plan (proposed):
1) Receive signed authorization from Acme.
2) Infra verifies identifiers and creates an internal deletion job (target: hotstore removal within 24 hours).
3) Neha/legal generates deletion confirmation artifacts (signed PDF) and records the approval in RED-55678.
4) Schedule backup sweep and aggregation re-compute if requested.

I will create the internal job and post updates to RED-55678. Sergio — I can start once we have the authorization and identifier confirmation.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
